div.div: One night a mysterious and unexplained phenomenon occurs in the nine provinces. Five years later Chu Feng, a regular outer disciple of the Azure Dragon school, awakens one of the mysterious nine lightning beasts. And discovers an egg sealed inside him.

To avenge his older brother, an orphan named Jongli Chu killed Hwang Jung, a Heaven-slaying sect disciple. Following the death of Hwang-Jung, he joined the Imitating Blade killer of Soul-killing Chambers to avoid the pursuit of the Heaven-slaying Sect. However, a huge mess called ten chastisements was waiting for him. To escape the shadow of chastisement, he has no choice but to become a Legendary Death God! Can Jongli Chu become a Death God and find freedom in the stifling rules created by the Orthodox Sects? (Source: Naver, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.
